summary: Quiet residential kerb on a flatter crest, homes 15-17 m back.

drivers.seclusion: Houses with front gardens sit 15-17 m from the kerb; homes opposite 13-15 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Open kerb with room to pull in; a few cars park along it.
drivers.convention: No signs; scattered cars on the kerb, no overnight habit visible.

flags: Sandy Creek 64 m away; low end under 10 m elevation
sun_shade: Open; trees at 100-140 m shade the west side in the morning.

best_section.where: Bowaga Street west kerb, on the crest mid-street
